summary.en: Daily-build channel of VS Code. The winget manifest lists VSCodeSetup-arm64 and VSCodeUserSetup-arm64 installers.
summary.zh-TW: VS Code 的每日建置版本，winget 清單提供 VSCodeSetup-arm64 與 VSCodeUserSetup-arm64 安裝程式。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
